title: skills: stale teaching after the ui merge and the moved-verbatim refactors — objectui as a separate repo, three dead SKILL.md anchors, bootstrap.md pins 18.1.0, examples omit sharingModel, retired plugin-ai eval, $empty untaught
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAmFFuy5ap2gXYq25sy

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed) · class: b (the skill contradicts what it or the contract declares) with one coverage row named as such · reach: every agent that reads `@objectstack/skills@18.3.0`; items 1 and 3 are also what a human sees first when opening the catalog.
Filed from the skills review thread on the maintainer's words, verbatim (2026-11-07): 「按照你的建议立卡」 · 「时间久了，立卡的时候重新确认一下问题」. Every item re-read on `main` `aa3e21cc` (2026-11-07); review report https://claude.ai/artifact/UXUaprHxBYrXE8DfJpfRGU (P1 section). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane; item 2's generator half lives in `packages/spec/scripts` and may be split to `domain:spec`.

## Items (one PR, or two at whole-file boundaries)

1. **ObjectUI is still "a separate repo".** `skills/README.md:138` "`../objectui` — Studio UI (separate repo)" with a link to the archived repository; `skills/objectui/README.md:3` (skills.sh badge for `objectstack-ai/objectui`), `:10` (`npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectui`), `:64` (repository link); `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md:303` links the gantt README at `github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/main/…`. The UI lives at `ui/` in this repository since #25752 and the objectui skill ships inside `@objectstack/skills` since #25832. Fix: point at `ui/` and the one pinned `experimental_sync` install the catalog README teaches at `:18-24`.
2. **The catalog index omits objectui.** `packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts:287` filters skill directories by `startsWith('objectstack-')`, so the generated index in `skills/README.md` and the docs page list ten skills and never the eleventh, while `skills/README.md:114-134` routes to `objectui` by hand. Fix: filter on "has `SKILL.md` and is not `metadata.internal`" (the predicate `template-consistency.test.ts` already applies), or state in the README why objectui is listed apart.
3. **Three anchors into sections that no longer exist in SKILL.md** (left by the "moved verbatim" refactors): `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md:961` → `../SKILL.md#lifecycle-hooks`; `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/plugin-lifecycle.md:259` → `../SKILL.md#complete-plugin-example` (the section is `references/plugin-development.md` `## Complete Plugin Example`); `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/service-registry.md:147-149` → `../SKILL.md#well-known-plugin-names--services` (no such heading anywhere). The same sentence says the table has "13 rows" — a hand-written count #27522's sweep missed; delete the number per that ruling.
4. **`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md:147-148`** pins `"@objectstack/spec": "18.1.0"` / `"@objectstack/runtime": "18.1.0"` in the starting `package.json`, while every SKILL.md frontmatter and the published package are `18.3.0`. #25666 fixed this file from `^17.0.0` to an exact version once; it drifted again because nothing reads the body (see the gates card filed alongside).
5. **Examples omit `sharingModel`.** `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:65` says a publish with no authored `sharingModel` is refused with `security-owd-unset` (maintainer ruling 2026-08-13). Yet `rules/relationships.md` has 12 `ObjectSchema.create` calls and 2 `sharingModel`; `rules/lifecycle.md` 4/0; `rules/datasources.md` 1/0; `skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md` 1/0; `references/plugin-development.md` 1/0. An AI copies the example and meets the refusal the skill itself describes. Fix: author `sharingModel` on every complete object example (fragments that show one key may say so).
6. **System columns declared as fields.** `skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md:45-46` declares `created_at` / `created_by` as ordinary fields; `rules/indexing.md:210-212` indexes `tenant_id` as if authored. `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:3121` injects the audit columns through `systemFields.audit` (default true) and the tenant column through `systemFields.tenant`. The implementer confirms whether an explicit declaration is refused or merely shadowed, then rewrites the examples with business fields and one sentence on `systemFields`.
7. **A retired package in an eval.** `skills/objectui/evals/project-setup.json:20` expects the answer to list `@object-ui/plugin-ai`; the package was retired by #25921 and #27048 removed it from the guides but not from this fixture, so the eval now rewards a wrong answer. Fix: replace with a live plugin from `ui/packages/`.
8. **Coverage row (not a wrong sentence):** `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md:5-27` (Operator Reference) and `SKILL.md:125` teach `$null` / `$exists` but never `$empty`, which `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts:1829` / `:1905` declare on the operator schemas and which is the lowering target of the view filter pair `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` (`:2760-2763`). Implementer first confirms `$empty` is accepted on the query `where` path (FILTER_OPERATORS membership, `:3367`), then adds the row; `$regex` / `$options` stay out (retired at protocol 17, `migrations/entries/semantic/17.filter-regex-options-retired.ts`).
9. Optional, one line: `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md:128` lists `objectstack-pm-dispatch` in the `skills remove` roster with no word that the skill was deleted (#17311); a reader takes it for a live skill. Add "(removed in 18; present only in older installs)".

## Acceptance

- Relative links and `#anchors` under `skills/**` resolve (the implementer runs a link walk; the gates card proposes making it a check).
- Every complete object example carries `sharingModel`; `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-docs`, liveness, token ratchet green; evals touched for items 5–8.
- **Level:** `skills/**` text (Tier H) plus, for item 2, `packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset (and `'@objectstack/spec': patch` if the generator moves), `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Dedupe (REST search, open and closed)

- `objectui "separate repo"` → 111; #25832, #25752, #27141 closed (the merge itself), none rewrites these lines.
- `skills README objectui index build-skill-docs` → 14; #27522 closed notes the "10 skills" count is computed — the computation is what excludes objectui.
- `data-hooks.md lifecycle-hooks anchor broken link` → 2 (#14297, #13675 closed, the restructures that moved the sections).
- `bootstrap.md pinned version drift skills` → 2; #25666 closed (previous fix).
- `skills examples omit sharingModel security-owd-unset` → 11; #14297 closed explained `sharingModel`, examples untouched.
- `examples-objects.md created_at created_by audit columns` → 0.
- `plugin-ai eval` → 22; #27048 closed (guides only).
- `"$empty" skills objectstack-query filters` → 69, none.

Related: #25832, #25752, #27522, #25666, #27048, #14297, #17311.
